title: 7th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/2024).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/2024 to 4/2024).
First reading of the State Debt Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.
First reading of the State Fiscal Responsibility Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Thulusdhoo MP Ibrahim Naseem.
First reading of a resolution by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to find out the view of members of the 20th Majlis on the number of MPs increasing every five years.

From the Speaker's desk: under Article 93(a) of the Constitution, the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to sign the "Samoa Agreement" (EU and OACPS partnership agreement) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve earlier minutes, introduce the State Debt and Fiscal Responsibility bills and a resolution on the growing number of MPs, and send the Samoa Agreement to committee.
